The Cybersecurity Engineer will provide technical expertise in the evaluation, integration, implementation, and optimization of SOC technologies, including Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS). The successful candidate will collaborate with cybersecurity and Network Operations Center (NOC) personnel, contribute to operational and cybersecurity strategies, and mentor junior analysts to strengthen incident investigation capabilities and overall SOC performance. This position requires a strong technical foundation in enterprise cybersecurity operations, analytical problem-solving skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a mission-focused environment. Location: Chesapeake, Virginia Work Arrangement: On-site Position Type: Full-Time Clearance: Active Secret Key Responsibilities Security Operations and Incident Response Support daily SOC operations, including continuous security monitoring, threat detection, incident analysis, and incident response activities. Identify, investigate, and analyze potential cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, and suspicious network activity. Support security incident investigations to determine root cause, assess potential impact, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Coordinate with the Cyber Incident and Event Management team during security incidents, escalations, and high-priority operational events. Support continuous improvement of incident response procedures, security monitoring capabilities, and operational workflows. Security Engineering and Technology Integration Provide cybersecurity engineering expertise to support market research, technology assessments, product evaluations, prototyping, integration, development, deployment, operation, and maintenance of SOC technologies. Evaluate emerging cybersecurity tools, technologies, and methodologies to identify opportunities to improve threat detection, incident response, and operational efficiency. Develop, implement, and maintain custom SIEM rules, correlation logic, alerts, dashboards, and other detection content. Tune and optimize SIEM and IDS/IPS platforms to improve detection accuracy, reduce false positives, and enhance security monitoring effectiveness. Support the implementation and continuous improvement of security tools, processes, and technical capabilities in alignment with customer requirements. Threat Detection and Security Analysis Analyze security events, alerts, and log data to identify potential indicators of compromise and malicious activity. Support the use and optimization of enterprise security monitoring technologies, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), and related security platforms. Maintain current knowledge of cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, industry best practices, and incident response methodologies. Recommend improvements to detection capabilities, security configurations, investigative processes, and operational procedures. Technical Leadership and Mentorship Train, guide, and mentor junior security analysts in effective incident investigation, evidence analysis, root-cause determination, and escalation procedures. Promote consistent application of SOC procedures, investigative standards, and incident documentation practices. Provide technical guidance and subject matter expertise to support the development of SOC personnel and operational capabilities. Operational Coordination and Strategic Support Coordinate with collocated, on-site NOC personnel to support effective communication, incident coordination, and resolution of network security issues. Contribute to the development and refinement of cybersecurity strategies, operational plans, and process improvement initiatives. Participate in special projects, technical assessments, and other assignments supporting customer and program objectives. Prepare, analyze, and provide operational, technical, and cybersecurity data and reports requested by the Program Manager and corporate office. Support additional cybersecurity engineering and SOC operational requirements as assigned. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Informatics, Information Systems, or a related technical field. Active Secret clearance At least five (5) years of full-time professional experience directly related to cybersecurity engineering, security operations, threat detection, incident response, or comparable job functions. Current Security+ certification or an equivalent or higher DoD 8570/8140-aligned qualification meeting the applicable IAT Level II requirement. Demonstrated knowledge of cybersecurity operations, security monitoring, threat detection, incident investigation, and incident response processes. Ability to analyze security events, investigate potential threats, identify root causes, and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to communicate effectively with cybersecurity personnel, network operations teams, program leadership, and corporate stakeholders. Ability to work collaboratively in a mission-focused operational environment. Ability and willingness to work on-site at the customer's facility in Chesapeake, Virginia. This is not a remote or work-from-home position. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with enterprise SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, or comparable cybersecurity monitoring and incident response platforms. Experience authoring, implementing, testing, and tuning custom SIEM detection rules, correlation logic, alerts, and dashboards. Experience reducing false positives and improving detection efficacy through security tool optimization and alert tuning. Experience conducting cybersecurity incident investigations, threat analysis, root-cause analysis, and incident remediation. Experience evaluating, integrating, deploying, and maintaining cybersecurity technologies within an enterprise environment. Experience training or mentoring junior cybersecurity analysts. Experience coordinating cybersecurity operations with NOC personnel or other technical operations teams. Experience supporting cybersecurity strategy, operational planning, and continuous process improvement. Required Certification Candidates must possess CompTIA Security+ or an equivalent or higher certification that satisfies the applicable DoD IAT Level II requirement. Acceptable certifications may include, subject to current DoD qualification requirements: CompTIA Security+ CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CyS90A+) Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP) GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC) Certified Network Defender (CND) Cisco Certified Network Associate Security (CCNA Security), where applicable under current qualification rules Certifications must meet the customer's applicable workforce qualification and contract requirements. Work Environment This position is based on-site at the customer's Security Operations Center in Chesapeake, Virginia. The Cybersecurity Engineer will work closely with SOC personnel, the Cyber Incident and Event Management team, collocated NOC personnel, and program leadership to support continuous monitoring, incident response, and ongoing improvement of the customer's cybersecurity posture. The anticipated salary range for this role is $93,000 to $97,000 annually. The anticipated salary range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. The final starting salary will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, including the selected candidate's qualifications, skills, relevant experience, education, certifications, and work location (where applicable), as well as internal equity and market considerations. We use E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

review_candidates.title: IT硬件主管(J10027)
review_candidates.company: 利莱森玛电机科技(福州)有限公司
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 职责描述： 1. IT基础设施管理：负责公司服务器、存储、网络设备等基础设施的规划、建设、优化与运维，确保系统高效稳定运行。 2. 桌面维护与用户支持：统筹公司PC、打印机、PDA等终端设备的运维管理，制定标准化桌面运维流程，确保用户高效使用。 3. 信息安全管理：建立和维护公司信息安全体系，负责安全策略制定、漏洞扫描、补丁管理、权限控制、防攻击防泄漏、文件保密等级管理、数据备份与恢复，确保信息系统安全合规及其用户培训。 4. 操作系统与数据库运维：负责Windows/Linux操作系统、SQL Server数据库的日常运维，包括安装、配置、优化、监控与故障排除，保障核心系统稳定运行。 5. IT资产与账号权限管理：统一管理公司IT资产及用户账号权限，定期进行权限审查，保证合规性与安全性。 6. 应急响应与容灾演练：组织信息安全应急演练，制定灾备方案并实施，提升应对网络攻击和系统故障的能力。 7. 供应商与外部合作：协调硬件、网络及安全服务供应商，监督合同执行，确保服务交付质量。 8. 团队管理与协作：负责硬件组团队的日常管理与培养，推动跨部门合作，提升整体运维效率和服务质量。 任职要求： 1. 教育背景：本科及以上学历，计算机、信息安全、网络工程或相关专业。 2. 工作经验：5年以上IT基础设施运维和信息安全管理经验，至少2年团队管理经验。 3. 技术能力： 操作系统与数据库：精通Windows Server、Linux操作系统，熟悉AD域控、组策略。精通SQL Server或Oracle数据库的部署、维护、优化与备份恢复。 网络与虚拟化：熟悉主流网络设备（Cisco等）的配置与管理，具备虚拟化技术（VMware、Hyper-V、KVM）实践经验。 信息安全：熟悉防火墙、入侵检测、防病毒、零信任等安全产品和方案，具备ISO27001、等保合规落地经验。能够独立进行安全加固、风险评估和应急响应。 自动化与监控：掌握Zabbix、Nagios、Prometheus等监控工具，熟悉Shell/PowerShell/Python脚本实现自动化运维。 云与混合架构：了解AWS、Azure、阿里云等云平台的基础设施与安全管理。 4. 业务理解：熟悉装配制造业IT场景，对工厂终端设备管理、MES/ERP对接、生产网络安全有实际理解。 5. 知识技能：具备较强的学习能力，熟练使用常见运维管理工具（如Service-now、Ansible、JumpServer、CMDB、Confluence等）。 6. 解决问题：能独立诊断并解决复杂的系统与网络问题，具备优化业务流程与运维体系的能力。 7. 沟通表达：具备良好的沟通能力和跨部门协作能力，能够有效推动项目落地。英语听说读写能力良好。 8. 管理经验：熟悉ITIL、DevSecOps理念，具备带领团队执行变更、发布、问题与事件管理的经验。能够根据公司战略灵活调整团队任务与优先级。持有CISSP、CISM、ITIL、PMP等认证者优先。
